EXT.evidence: Takes charge of the conversation with strong declarations and multiple interjections (asks about the simian, asks whose turn it is, corrects the game score).

AGR.evidence: Delivers harsh, unsympathetic judgments (“will never feel like a father,” “will never feel connected”) and nitpicks the score, showing low warmth/cooperation.

CON.evidence: Tracks procedural details and enforces rules in the game (asks whose turn it is; insists that playing “IDNEY” gets zero points).

NEU.evidence: Speaks with certainty and composure, confidently correcting others without signs of anxiety or sensitivity.

OPN.evidence: Makes absolute, dogmatic predictions (“never”) and focuses on strict rule application, showing little openness to alternative views.
